description: This Java file defines an immutable class 'ImmutableEffectedPermissions' implementing the 'EffectedPermissions' interface. It manages granted and revoked permissions, provides factory methods for creation from collections and JSON, and overrides standard methods like equals, hashCode, and toString.

classes.name: ImmutableEffectedPermissions
classes.description: Immutable class representing the permissions that are granted and revoked, with capabilities to create instances from collections and JSON objects, and to serialize back to JSON.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance from given collections of granted and revoked permission strings.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an EffectedPermissions instance from a JSON object representation.

methods.name: getPermissions
methods.description: Returns permissions based on the specified permission effect (GRANT or REVOKE).

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the object to a JSON representation according to the schema version.
